description: Entries from the Journal - what was written down at the time about a decision, and why. Use for 'what did I say when I bought this', 'what was I thinking in March', or any question about past reasoning rather than past numbers.

limit.description: How many entries to return. Defaults to 20.

search.description: Optional. Only return entries whose title or body contains this text.
